text: Social media platforms do more harm than good to society.
Artificial intelligence development should be strictly regulated by international treaties.
Smartphones should be completely banned inside primary and secondary school classrooms.
Tech companies should be held legally liable for user-generated content on their platforms.
AI tools like ChatGPT should be actively integrated into school and university curricula.
Standardized testing does more harm than good in assessing student potential.
Traditional university degrees are becoming obsolete in the modern tech economy.
Financial literacy and investing should be mandatory subjects in secondary education.
Remote work options should be legally guaranteed for all eligible office employees.
A four-day workweek should become the national labor standard.
Social media influencer culture has a predominantly negative impact on young people.
Cash should be completely phased out in favor of digital payments.
Universal Basic Income is necessary to protect workers against widespread AI automation.
Gig economy platforms should be required to classify gig workers as full employees.
Commercial advertising targeting children under the age of 16 should be completely prohibited.
Restaurant tipping culture has become toxic and should be replaced by fair base wages.
Nuclear energy is indispensable for achieving global net-zero carbon targets.
Single-use plastics should be banned globally with strict economic penalties.
Aggressive carbon taxes should be enforced even if they raise consumer living costs.
Government subsidies for electric vehicles should be redirected toward expanding public transit.
Ultra-processed foods should carry mandatory health warning labels similar to tobacco products.
Wearable health trackers cause more anxiety and hyper-vigilance than measurable medical benefits.
Mental health days should be recognized as legally protected paid sick leave.
Autonomous lethal weapons systems powered by AI should be permanently outlawed under international law.
